content: ditto -c -k --keepParent preserves symlinks, resource forks and extended attributes correctly for macOS app bundles and is Apple's recommended tool for zipping bundles for notarization/distribution; a zip made with 'zip -qr' can produce 'signature of the binary is invalid' failures at notarization/verification because plain zip mishandles nested symlinks (e.g. Framework Versions/Current) and metadata. tar (bsdtar) also preserves symlinks and is a reasonable CLI alternative; Finder's compress can sequester extended attributes which is undesirable.
